profile.headline: Autonomy Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm an autonomy software engineer at Merlin. Prior to working at Merlin I was a robotics software engineer at Nextera Robotics where I worked with mobile robots in the construction industry.  I graduated with a BS in mechanical engineering from Harvard University. I've conducted research in cooperative robotics at Harvard, taught a lab as a Teaching Assistant alongside two industrial robotic arms, and in my free time I like to build cool things.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
(ES159/259) Head UR5e Robotics Lab Instructor – Ran weekly lab session, designed and implemented new lab assignment, graded all lab reports, wrote ROS wrappers for MATLAB-UR5e gripper compatibility
(ES96) Junior Tutorial Course Assistant – Assisted professor in a seminar-style class designed to foster team-building and leadership skills across engineering disciplines

positions.title: Robotics Researcher
positions.description: In the summer of 2022, I was a PRISE research fellow under Justin Werfel, working to develop novel force sensing capabilities on a modular robot for cooperative robotics applications.
